integrity: A fully supplied mathematical proof is supported by exact finite implementations; those tests cannot certify the infinite limiting law. Closely related earlier generalized-Schemmel mean theorems are acknowledged. Novelty remains subject to unindexed prior results.
scientific_limitations: Convergence is weak, with fixed-index moments; no effective Kolmogorov rate, density formula, optimal error, or security statement. The Euler product, not a numerical truncation, defines the constant.
title: An atomless Euler-product law for the normalized variant totient
